llm_response.reason: The website displays professionalism consistent with a global B2B analytics and consulting service provider, lacking any of the key scam characteristics: no unrealistic offers/promises, no urgency tactics, no ambiguous privacy/payment details, no fake endorsements or testimonials, not handling unrelated products, and provides detailed company, support, and legal info. WHOIS confirms registration to an established UK corporation since 2008. The presence of a fraud warning and legal compliance links further supports legitimacy. The SSL issue alone is not sufficient to label it a scam.
